newsitem.title: UK: Charter shares gain as results please.
newsitem.headline: Charter shares gain as results please.

text.p: Charter Plc shares jumped on Tuesday after the engineering group's results gave no negative surprise and the firm highlighted its focus on boosting shareholder value, dealers said.
The stock was up 22p at 801 by 0941 GMT in volume of 457,720 shares, continuing a rebound from a steady decline sparked by its cautious statement last September.
"There was a sense of relief at the absence of bad news," said one market-maker, "the results were pretty much in line and the feeling is things could be improving from here."

Charter said its underlying profit from continuing businesses rose 3.3 percent to 92.7 million stg and said the disposal of its 65 percent stake in building materials group Cape was an important strategic step.
Chairman and chief executive Jeffrey Herbert said the sale would allow it to concentrate resources on market-leading businesses which had the potential to achieve better returns.
The company said it continued to look for acquisition opportunities which would enhance shareholder value and was in a strong financial position to take another step forward.
